description: Source code for HttpServerProperties class managing HTTP server configurations, including support for SPDY, QUIC, alternative services, and persistence mechanisms within Chromium project.

classes.name: HttpServerProperties
classes.description: Manages HTTP server configurations, supports SPDY, QUIC, alternative services, network stats, and persistence.

classes.name: HttpServerProperties::ServerInfo
classes.description: Holds server support info, alternative services, and network stats.

classes.name: HttpServerProperties::ServerInfoMapKey
classes.description: Key for server info map, combining server address and network key.

classes.name: HttpServerProperties::QuicServerInfoMapKey
classes.description: Key for QUIC server info map, based on server ID and network key.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::SupportsRequestPriority
methods.description: Checks if server supports request priority via SPDY or QUIC.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::GetSupportsSpdy
methods.description: Returns whether server supports SPDY.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::SetSupportsSpdy
methods.description: Sets SPDY support for a server.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::RequiresHTTP11
methods.description: Checks if server requires HTTP/1.1.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::SetHTTP11Required
methods.description: Marks server as requiring HTTP/1.1.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::MaybeForceHTTP11
methods.description: Forces HTTP/1.1 on SSL config if required.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::GetAlternativeServiceInfos
methods.description: Retrieves valid alternative services for a server.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::SetHttp2AlternativeService
methods.description: Sets HTTP/2 alternative service.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::SetQuicAlternativeService
methods.description: Sets QUIC alternative service.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::SetAlternativeServices
methods.description: Sets multiple alternative services.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::MarkAlternativeServiceBroken
methods.description: Marks an alternative service as broken.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::MarkAlternativeServiceBrokenUntilDefaultNetworkChanges
methods.description: Marks an alternative service as broken until network change.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::MarkAlternativeServiceRecentlyBroken
methods.description: Marks an alternative service as recently broken.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::IsAlternativeServiceBroken
methods.description: Checks if an alternative service is broken.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::WasAlternativeServiceRecentlyBroken
methods.description: Checks if an alternative service was recently broken.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::ConfirmAlternativeService
methods.description: Confirms and persists an alternative service.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::OnDefaultNetworkChanged
methods.description: Handles network change event.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::GetAlternativeServiceInfoAsValue
methods.description: Serializes alternative service info for debugging.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::SetLastLocalAddressWhenQuicWorked
methods.description: Records last local address when QUIC succeeded.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::ClearLastLocalAddressWhenQuicWorked
methods.description: Clears last local address record.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::SetServerNetworkStats
methods.description: Sets network stats for a server.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::ClearServerNetworkStats
methods.description: Clears network stats for a server.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::GetServerNetworkStats
methods.description: Retrieves network stats for a server.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::SetQuicServerInfo
methods.description: Stores QUIC server info.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::GetQuicServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves QUIC server info.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::max_server_configs_stored_in_properties
methods.description: Returns max number of server configs stored.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::SetMaxServerConfigsStoredInProperties
methods.description: Sets max number of server configs stored.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::SetBrokenAlternativeServicesDelayParams
methods.description: Configures delay parameters for broken alternative services.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::IsInitialized
methods.description: Checks if properties are loaded.

methods.name: HttpServerProperties::OnExpireBrokenAlternativeService
methods.description: Expires a broken alternative service.
